samples.question: Start at the ringed badge and follow the one connected route through stations 1 to 11 in increasing number order. The token has four states A, B, C, and D. The badge colors mean red=A, green=B, blue=C, and purple=D. At each station, a filled right-pointing triangle advances one state cyclically A-B-C-D-A, a filled left-pointing triangle retreats one state, and an outlined square leaves the state unchanged. Ignore the starting position when looking for a return. After the token has first left its starting state, which numbered station is the first station at which the token has the starting state again? Answer 1 through 11.
